decks.domain: Traffic laws, speed, stopping, turning and right of way

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: _____ traffic laws and lawful police directions while operating on streets or highways.
cards.back: Obey traffic laws and lawful police directions while operating on streets or highways.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: When an officer signals a _____ , remain calm and pull over safely.
cards.back: When an officer signals a stop, remain calm and pull over safely.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Be ready to present a driver’s license, vehicle registration and current insurance evidence during a traffic _____ .
cards.back: Be ready to present a driver’s license, vehicle registration and current insurance evidence during a traffic stop.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Remain inside the vehicle unless the officer directs otherwise and keep hands _____ .
cards.back: Remain inside the vehicle unless the officer directs otherwise and keep hands visible.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide permits asking an officer in an unmarked _____ and without a uniform for identification.
cards.back: The guide permits asking an officer in an unmarked vehicle and without a uniform for identification.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: _____ signs, signals and pavement controls.
cards.back: Follow signs, signals and pavement controls.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: When an intersection signal is _____ working, treat the intersection as an all-way stop.
cards.back: When an intersection signal is not working, treat the intersection as an all-way stop.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A driver must maintain _____ , proper control of the vehicle.
cards.back: A driver must maintain reasonable, proper control of the vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Posted speed limits describe ideal conditions rather than a _____ speed for every situation.
cards.back: Posted speed limits describe ideal conditions rather than a safe speed for every situation.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Reduce speed when wet or icy pavement, poor visibility or heavy traffic makes the posted speed _____ .
cards.back: Reduce speed when wet or icy pavement, poor visibility or heavy traffic makes the posted speed unsafe.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Check the speedometer because perceived speed can be misleading _____ leaving a fast multilane road.
cards.back: Check the speedometer because perceived speed can be misleading after leaving a fast multilane road.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The general speed rule requires a _____ speed for traffic, location, road, light and weather conditions.
cards.back: The general speed rule requires a reasonable speed for traffic, location, road, light and weather conditions.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Do not exceed a posted _____ speed or travel below a posted minimum.
cards.back: Do not exceed a posted maximum speed or travel below a posted minimum.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Do not drive so _____ that traffic is obstructed.
cards.back: Do not drive so slowly that traffic is obstructed.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Slow in school and playground areas and at a school crossing when _____ are present.
cards.back: Slow in school and playground areas and at a school crossing when children are present.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Racing, speed contests and speed exhibitions on public roads are _____ in the guide.
cards.back: Racing, speed contests and speed exhibitions on public roads are unlawful in the guide.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Do not cross the _____ or barrier of a divided highway except at an approved crossover.
cards.back: Do not cross the median or barrier of a divided highway except at an approved crossover.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: _____ changing lanes, check mirrors, check over the shoulder, look for others entering that lane and signal.
cards.back: Before changing lanes, check mirrors, check over the shoulder, look for others entering that lane and signal.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Never make a hurried, _____ lane change just to avoid missing a turn or exit.
cards.back: Never make a hurried, unsafe lane change just to avoid missing a turn or exit.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: If there is no _____ gap for a lane change, wait rather than force entry into the lane.
cards.back: If there is no safe gap for a lane change, wait rather than force entry into the lane.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Let a faster vehicle in the intended lane pass _____ moving into its path.
cards.back: Let a faster vehicle in the intended lane pass before moving into its path.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide _____ changing lanes while approaching or traveling through an intersection.
cards.back: The guide prohibits changing lanes while approaching or traveling through an intersection.

decks.domain: Traffic laws, speed, stopping, turning and right of way

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Stop at least _____ feet from a school bus stopped for children boarding or leaving, except where a stated roadway exception applies.
cards.back: Stop at least thirty feet from a school bus stopped for children boarding or leaving, except where a stated roadway exception applies.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A bus’s _____ warning lamps announce an approaching stop; red lamps and the stop arm activate when it stops.
cards.back: A bus’s yellow warning lamps announce an approaching stop; red lamps and the stop arm activate when it stops.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: For a stopped school bus, drivers normally stop whether approaching it or traveling _____ it.
cards.back: For a stopped school bus, drivers normally stop whether approaching it or traveling behind it.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A bus completely outside the roadway in a loading zone where _____ cannot cross the road is a stated stopping exception.
cards.back: A bus completely outside the roadway in a loading zone where pedestrians cannot cross the road is a stated stopping exception.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A driver on the opposite roadway need not stop when an impassable ditch, _____ or barrier separates it from the stopped bus.
cards.back: A driver on the opposite roadway need not stop when an impassable ditch, median or barrier separates it from the stopped bus.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide also exempts opposite-direction traffic on _____ - or five-lane roads separated by a dedicated two-way left-turn lane from stopping for the bus.
cards.back: The guide also exempts opposite-direction traffic on four- or five-lane roads separated by a dedicated two-way left-turn lane from stopping for the bus.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: On a _____ -lane roadway without a separating barrier or a stated turn-lane exception, stop for the school bus.
cards.back: On a four-lane roadway without a separating barrier or a stated turn-lane exception, stop for the school bus.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A road with _____ lane each way and a middle two-way left-turn lane still requires both directions to stop for the school bus.
cards.back: A road with one lane each way and a middle two-way left-turn lane still requires both directions to stop for the school bus.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: At an intersection, slow and prepare to stop because having _____ does not guarantee safety.
cards.back: At an intersection, slow and prepare to stop because having priority does not guarantee safety.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Prepare a turn early, scan surrounding traffic, signal and select the appropriate lane _____ turning.
cards.back: Prepare a turn early, scan surrounding traffic, signal and select the appropriate lane before turning.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide requires signaling and occupying the proper lane at least _____ feet before a turn.
cards.back: The guide requires signaling and occupying the proper lane at least one hundred feet before a turn.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Begin a _____ turn from the far-right lane unless markings permit simultaneous right turns from multiple lanes.
cards.back: Begin a right turn from the far-right lane unless markings permit simultaneous right turns from multiple lanes.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Do not swing left before making a _____ turn.
cards.back: Do not swing left before making a right turn.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Slow _____ a turn and finish in the appropriate lane.
cards.back: Slow before a turn and finish in the appropriate lane.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: While waiting to turn _____ , keep the front wheels straight so a rear impact does not push the vehicle into opposing traffic.
cards.back: While waiting to turn left, keep the front wheels straight so a rear impact does not push the vehicle into opposing traffic.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Do not cut a _____ -turn corner so sharply that the vehicle enters the path of traffic approaching from the left.
cards.back: Do not cut a left-turn corner so sharply that the vehicle enters the path of traffic approaching from the left.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A marked _____ -turn-only lane permits only a left turn.
cards.back: A marked left-turn-only lane permits only a left turn.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Do not turn around on a hill or curve if approaching drivers cannot see the vehicle from _____ feet in either direction.
cards.back: Do not turn around on a hill or curve if approaching drivers cannot see the vehicle from five hundred feet in either direction.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A shared center turn lane serves left turns from either _____ and cannot be used to pass.
cards.back: A shared center turn lane serves left turns from either direction and cannot be used to pass.

decks.domain: Traffic laws, speed, stopping, turning and right of way

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide limits travel within a shared center left-turn lane to _____ feet.
cards.back: The guide limits travel within a shared center left-turn lane to two hundred feet.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Before entering a shared turn lane, check ahead, check mirrors, signal _____ and check the left blind spot.
cards.back: Before entering a shared turn lane, check ahead, check mirrors, signal left and check the left blind spot.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Watch for traffic entering from driveways or side roads before making a _____ turn from the shared lane.
cards.back: Watch for traffic entering from driveways or side roads before making a left turn from the shared lane.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Traffic moves _____ around the center island of a roundabout.
cards.back: Traffic moves counterclockwise around the center island of a roundabout.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Traffic entering a roundabout yields to vehicles already _____ .
cards.back: Traffic entering a roundabout yields to vehicles already circulating.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Select the proper lane _____ entering a multilane roundabout.
cards.back: Select the proper lane before entering a multilane roundabout.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide directs drivers _____ to pass or change lanes inside a multilane roundabout.
cards.back: The guide directs drivers not to pass or change lanes inside a multilane roundabout.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Follow roundabout signs and lane markings to the intended _____ .
cards.back: Follow roundabout signs and lane markings to the intended exit.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Yield to pedestrians and bicyclists at a roundabout as well as to _____ vehicles.
cards.back: Yield to pedestrians and bicyclists at a roundabout as well as to circulating vehicles.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Do _____ travel alongside a truck or bus in a roundabout.
cards.back: Do not travel alongside a truck or bus in a roundabout.

decks.domain: Traffic laws, speed, stopping, turning and right of way

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Use signals to communicate a planned turn, lane change, slowdown or _____ .
cards.back: Use signals to communicate a planned turn, lane change, slowdown or stop.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Signals may be communicated by vehicle lamps or the _____ arm.
cards.back: Signals may be communicated by vehicle lamps or the left arm.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: The guide requires a turn signal to continue for at least _____ feet before the turn.
cards.back: The guide requires a turn signal to continue for at least one hundred feet before the turn.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Use a _____ signal when leaving a parallel curb space to enter traffic.
cards.back: Use a left signal when leaving a parallel curb space to enter traffic.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Use a _____ signal before moving left to pass another vehicle.
cards.back: Use a left signal before moving left to pass another vehicle.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Do not use a _____ -sided turn signal as an invitation for another vehicle to pass.
cards.back: Do not use a one-sided turn signal as an invitation for another vehicle to pass.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Extending the _____ arm straight outward signals a left turn.
cards.back: Extending the left arm straight outward signals a left turn.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Bending the left arm upward signals a _____ turn.
cards.back: Bending the left arm upward signals a right turn.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Bending the _____ arm downward signals slowing or stopping.
cards.back: Bending the left arm downward signals slowing or stopping.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Right-of-way rules identify who must yield; a driver should not insist on _____ when doing so creates danger.
cards.back: Right-of-way rules identify who must yield; a driver should not insist on priority when doing so creates danger.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: At a _____ sign, slow and stop if needed, then proceed only without interfering with approaching traffic.
cards.back: At a yield sign, slow and stop if needed, then proceed only without interfering with approaching traffic.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A left-turning driver yields to oncoming vehicles, including _____ .
cards.back: A left-turning driver yields to oncoming vehicles, including bicycles.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: For an emergency vehicle using a siren and warning lamps, pull to the _____ clear of intersections and stop until it passes.
cards.back: For an emergency vehicle using a siren and warning lamps, pull to the right clear of intersections and stop until it passes.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Watch for additional emergency vehicles after the first _____ passes.
cards.back: Watch for additional emergency vehicles after the first one passes.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: _____ to pedestrians lawfully crossing in marked or unmarked crosswalks.
cards.back: Yield to pedestrians lawfully crossing in marked or unmarked crosswalks.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: Yield to a pedestrian using a guide dog or _____ cane, including a cane with a red tip.
cards.back: Yield to a pedestrian using a guide dog or white cane, including a cane with a red tip.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: At an uncontrolled intersection, _____ to vehicles already in it.
cards.back: At an uncontrolled intersection, yield to vehicles already in it.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: At a T junction, traffic entering from the ending road yields to traffic on the _____ .
cards.back: At a T junction, traffic entering from the ending road yields to traffic on the through road.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: A _____ entering a paved road from an unpaved road yields to traffic on the paved road.
cards.back: A driver entering a paved road from an unpaved road yields to traffic on the paved road.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: When returning from parking or entering from an alley, driveway or roadside, _____ to traffic on the main roadway.
cards.back: When returning from parking or entering from an alley, driveway or roadside, yield to traffic on the main roadway.

cards.front: Complete the guide’s rule: At a _____ -way stop when vehicles arrive simultaneously, the driver to the left yields to the driver on the right.
cards.back: At a four-way stop when vehicles arrive simultaneously, the driver to the left yields to the driver on the right.
